name: clauden
description: Posts to a webhook when the Claude Code model or reasoning effort changes. Nothing else — no session tracking, no prompts, no telemetry.

CLAUDEN_EMAIL.title: Your work email
CLAUDEN_EMAIL.description: Identifies you in the notifications. Required — sessions from an unconfigured install are reported as unidentified.

CLAUDEN_WEBHOOK.title: Webhook URL
CLAUDEN_WEBHOOK.description: Slack incoming webhook, or any endpoint accepting POST {"text": "..."}. Required — nothing is sent without it.
